title: Pokemon Hatterene VMAX 066/172 RRR VSTAR Universe s12a Japanese Mint/NM card.
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This is a rare and highly sought-after Pokémon card featuring the popular character Hatterene. It is from the VSTAR Universe set and has a RRR rarity, making it a valuable addition to any collection. The card is in Japanese language and has a foil finish.

With a card size of Japanese and an attribute of Psychic, this VMAX card has 320 HP and is manufactured in Japan. It is suitable for players aged 6+ and is perfect for those who love the Pokémon TCG game. The card number is 066/172 RRR and it comes with speciality attributes of VMAX. Get your hands on this amazing card today!
